name: Fly, The
overview: Westernmost of Lane Peak's three north face couloirs, and the gentlest. From the face base near 5,000 ft, go up and right through the obvious broad couloir; it narrows and steepens to a notch near 5,800 ft. For the summit or the usual walk-off, lose some height and traverse skiers left toward the saddle between Lane and Denman, then ascend the southeast aspect to where it joins the other lines, and scramble to the top. Avalanche hazard on the traverse that faces south may be significant despite a solid north side, because direct sun hits it all morning.
